name: Phalanx (CR90 corvette)
description: during the Conflict at Mylok IV.]] Habeen researchers used CR90 corvette Phalanx at the Mylok IV Conflict during the Galactic Civil War. Corvette Phalanx docked with Habeen containers at the Habeen deep-space research facility, rescuing critical hyperdrive technology from an attack by Nharwaak dissidents. The ship took heavy damage protecting the facility.
